sales.heroSubtitle: MedSociety is the healthcare directory for the El Paso and Ciudad Juárez border. Patients on both sides use it to find care, compare ratings, and call a clinic directly.
sales.howTitle: Three steps to your first patient
sales.howSubtitle: No contracts, no setup fee, and nothing to install. Most clinics finish in one sitting.
sales.step1Body: Clinic name, specialties, address, phone. That is the whole form, and it takes about five minutes.
sales.step2Body: Your clinic appears to patients searching your specialty in your city, in both English and Spanish.
sales.step3Body: We report how many people opened your profile each month, so you know what the listing is doing.
sales.cityElPasoBody: Patients searching for local dentists, primary care, urgent care and specialists, plus those comparing prices across the bridge.
sales.cityJuarezBody: Clinics serving both local patients and the steady flow of US visitors crossing for dental, vision and elective care.
sales.pricingTitle: Free to list. Pay only to stand out.
sales.pricingSubtitle: Every clinic gets a full listing at no cost. Promotion is optional and month to month.
sales.freeF1: Your clinic on the MedSociety map
sales.freeF4: Shown to English and Spanish searches
sales.proF2: Gold pin, sized larger on the map
sales.proF4: Full analytics on views and calls
sales.proF5: Included in the weekly patient digest
sales.formMessagePlaceholder: Opening hours, languages spoken, insurance accepted
sales.formPrivacy: We use this only to set up your listing. No newsletters.
sales.formThanksBody: Your request is in. Someone from MedSociety will email you within two business days to confirm your listing details.
sales.formFallback: We could not save that automatically.
sales.ctaBannerSubtitle: Patients are already searching your specialty in your city. Make sure your clinic is what they find.
sales.footer: © {{year}} MedSociety · Healthcare across the El Paso and Juárez border

discover.heroTitle: Find a clinic in El Paso or Ciudad Juárez
discover.heroSubtitle: Search 4,000 clinics and specialists across El Paso and Ciudad Juárez. Compare ratings, published prices and insurance before you call.

pricing.basicF1: Profile in the directory and on the map
pricing.basicF2: Claim and manage your own listing
pricing.basicF3: Found by patients on both sides of the border
pricing.promotedF2: Promoted pin on the map and priority in search
pricing.promotedF3: Included in the weekly patient newsletter
pricing.promotedF4: Monthly report of profile views and contacts
pricing.featuredF4: Quarterly SEO and AI visibility audit, plus priority support
pricing.terms: No setup fee, no contract, cancel whenever you want.
pricing.addonsTitle: Fill the schedule, not just the listing
pricing.addonsSubtitle: Being found is the first half. These are the services that turn a profile view into an appointment that shows up and pays.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp and AI chat
whatsapp.body: Automatic replies, online booking, and messages shared fairly across your staff. Hand any conversation to a person at any point.

payments.title: Online payments and prepay links
payments.body: Send a payment link over WhatsApp or SMS. Cards and digital wallets in USD and MXN, automatic receipts, and deposits that stop no-shows.

website.title: Professional website
website.body: A mobile-first site with your services, prices and booking, your Google Business profile set up, and domain and hosting managed for you.

reminders.title: Reminders and campaigns
reminders.body: Appointment reminders, up to four campaigns a month, and reactivation for patients you have not seen in a while. Messaging fees at cost.

seo.title: SEO and AI visibility audit
seo.body: Where you show up in search, maps and AI assistants, how you compare with the clinics near you, and what to fix first. Included quarterly with Destacado.

account.signInBody: Manage your clinic’s listing, photos and plan.
account.signUpBody: One account manages every listing you claim. Free, and it stays free.
account.checkInboxBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it and you are in.
account.claimBody: Tell us how we can confirm you work here. A person reviews every claim, usually within one business day.
account.claimSentBody: We will review it and email you. Nothing changes on your listing until it is approved.
account.claimNotFoundBody: That link points at a clinic we no longer hold.
account.evidenceHint: A work email on the clinic’s domain, a cédula profesional, or the phone number already on the listing.
account.evidencePlaceholder: I am the office manager. Our phone on this listing is my direct line, and my email is on our domain.
account.dashboardSubtitle: Everything on your listing, and what your plan includes.
account.noClinicBody: Find your practice in the directory and claim it. It takes a minute and it costs nothing.
account.pendingBody: A person is checking your claim. We will email you as soon as it is approved.
account.statsDisclaimer: Views and contacts are estimates, modelled from search demand for your specialty and area — not measured traffic. We will replace them with real figures as soon as tracking is live.
account.gapTitle: People are finding you and leaving
account.gapBody: We estimate around {{views}} people looked at this listing in the last month, and none of them had a contact button to press. A promoted listing adds one.
account.fieldAddressHint: Shown on your listing. Changing it does not move your pin.
account.fieldDescriptionHint: A short paragraph patients read before they call. What you treat, who you are, what to expect.
account.locationNote: Need to move your pin on the map, change your specialty, or correct your rating? Email hello@medsociety.one — those are set by us so a listing cannot quietly relocate itself.
account.photosBody: Clinics with real photos get opened far more often than ones without. These appear on your listing, and the first is the cover.
account.photoTooBig: That file is over 5 MB. Please upload a smaller image.
